title: Prior art, and what novelty is claimed — 9 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit and how they are bound
description:
Prior art, and what novelty is claimed — 9 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit, one Lean namespace, wing the record. 9 close by exhaustion over a finite domain (by decide). Every one is sealed live in the append-only ledger.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used in this deposit's honest sense: correlation by derivation, not quantum entanglement, and no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 3 definition(s) are used by two or more theorems, binding 72 pair(s); the theorems fall into 1 strand(s), the largest of 9. Most binding: sources (9), kindOf (7), novelty (6).

2 · Imports. Built on: no other cluster. Built on it: no other cluster. Checking this cluster needs 1 file(s): src/proof/priorart.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 9 sealed receipts fold to dce2284f-5e64-85d5-92f0-c6bc93b315b9. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed on this run. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (2, 4, 5, 3, 4, 7, 4). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs observed among each theorem's seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: involution.lean (4 observed, 0.8 expected, lift 5.01), energy.lean (3 observed, 2.1 expected, lift 1.43), families.lean (6 observed, 4.19 expected, lift 1.43). A lift near 1 is what chance gives. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 14.92; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.47. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). Chance, measured: over 200 reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to (seeded, so every rebuild gives the same numbers), a best lift at least this high arose in 15.0% of them — consistent with chance.

Prior art. Declared unclassified. Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json. No novelty is claimed here.

The theorems.

  1. novelty_is_claimed_only_where_a_search_was_performed — sources.all (fun s => novelty s == false || kindOf s == 2) record
  2. this_deposit_claims_no_novelty_today — (sources.filter novelty).length = 0 record
  3. the_restated_sources_are_named_and_claim_nothing — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 0)).all (fun s => novelty s == false) record
  4. an_unsearched_source_claims_nothing — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).all (fun s => novelty s == false) record
  5. every_source_is_classified — sources.all (fun s => kindOf s == 0 || kindOf s == 1 || kindOf s == 2) record
  6. the_kinds_cover_every_source — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 0)).length + (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).length + (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 2)).length = sources.length record
  7. some_sources_are_unsearched — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).length > 0 record
  8. zero_claims_is_not_full_attribution — (sources.filter novelty).length = 0 ∧ (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).length > 0 record
  9. novelty_is_claimed_of_no_source — (sources.filter novelty).length = 0 record
